# Best Sonic Branding Agencies, a list by EightSix

> Two lists of sonic branding agencies, published by EightSix GmbH, a sonic branding agency in Berlin (founded 2021 as 86Tales). EightSix appears first on both lists, marked as the publisher's own agency. All other agencies are in alphabetical order, and no winner is named. Facts about other agencies come from their own websites and are linked in each entry.

## Pages

- [Best sonic branding agencies in Europe (2026)](https://bestsonicbrandingagency.com/): EightSix (Berlin), then Adelphoi Music, amp sound branding, DLMDD, GROVES Sound Branding, MassiveMusic, Sixième Son, Sonicbrand, TRO and why do birds. Includes price ranges, timelines and how to choose.
- [Beste Sonic-Branding-Agenturen in Deutschland (2026)](https://bestsonicbrandingagency.com/beste-sonic-branding-agenturen-deutschland/): EightSix (Berlin), danach amp sound branding, Audity, Campera Media, comevis, GROVES Sound Branding, TRO, WESOUND und why do birds.

## Publisher

- EightSix GmbH, Kollwitzstr. 76, 10435 Berlin, Germany. https://eightsix.com/
- Corrections: hi@eightsix.com
